title: Anne Donohue
description: Donohue supports allowing biological males to use girls’ locker rooms and restrooms.
body:
# Anne Donohue

# School Board Vice-Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/donohue-profile.jpg)

- **[Supports allowing](https://web.archive.org/web/20240205170240/https:/wjla.com/news/local/loudoun-county-virginia-school-board-candidatesanne-donohue-michael-rivera-democrat-republican-elections-november-2023-voting-vote-va-voters-education-gender-children-families-students-drug-use-substance-abuse-mental-health)** biological males to use girls’ locker rooms and restrooms.
- Donohue was a former attorney for the U.S. Dept of Justice. She ran for school board with an endorsement from the Democrat party - for that**[ she was cited](https://web.archive.org/web/20250528023557/https:/blueridgeleader.com/school-board-member-resigns-from-job-over-hatch-act-violation/)** with a violation of the Hatch Act. She was forced to come into “compliance with the law” and stepped down from her job as a U.S. attorney.
- Virginia law **[forbids](https://web.archive.org/web/20260320183857/https:/www.loudountimes.com/news/politics_and_government/loudoun-school-board-member-says-she-mistakenly-served-as-election-officer/article_ed90ab7a-d1d4-11ef-83ea-bfd2b2802dcc.html)** elected officials from serving as election officers, yet she applied and worked as an election officer.
